reviews.comment: I don't think he is teaching this class next year, but if he is, try to get him! There are around 8 bonus points ( Added to your final grade) !! The exams are not super easy, but manageable, and the practice exams help. Attendance is mandatory. Overall, this was a super chill class, especially compared to 202.
He did not let you know what your grade was in the class until after the semester was over and everything in his class was done. Doesn't seem like he wants to teach this class.

He did not really put a lot of effort into his lectures or tests. The grade in Canvas does not accurately reflect what your grade in the class is, you have to calculate that yourself. The homework and practice exams he gives you do not reflect what the exams are. He didn't even stay for his own final exam.
Give him a raise; he's a great teacher. 3 exams, no cumulative final, and homework online. Lectures are fun.

New to the system last year, he gave out SO much extra credit. If you attended class every time, you got a 5% percentage curve to your final grade. There were a bunch of other things as well... I went from a 79 to a 90. Literally an 11 point percentage curve. I was able to put less focus into this course and more into others!

Professor Hwang is such a kind and caring professor. The course is a bit hard but he is willing to help and hear you out. Make sure to do all the homework assignments, because the material on his practice exams weren't that helpful for the exam. He provides extra credit opportunities and curves his exams. He is really bubbly and funny.

Prof Taewon will go down as one of the most legendary professors of all time. He is one of the few professors that you can tell actually cares about teaching and making sure you understand the material. Attendance is mandatory but if you simply go and be engaged you can get bonus points at the end of the year. Class is actually enjoyable, take it.

Professor Wang is my goat. He is super chill; he genuinely cares about his students and puts forth a lot of effort to teach them. Lectures are mandatory but very interesting, and I never felt bored when he taught. The course is test-heavy, but the homework is informative, and he curves exams. He also has lots of extra credit opportunities.
